import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected="e71260f973e45da941535d526fd4e4b01477f7e2"

def run(args, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check,env=env)

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
branch=run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
if head != expected or branch != "feat/self-dogfood-20261007":
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected isolated state head={head} branch={branch}")

test=wt/"tests/test_cli.py"
text=test.read_text()
old='''            cleanup.assert_called_once_with(repo, candidate_ids=[], apply=False)
'''
new='''            cleanup.assert_called_once()
            called_repo = cleanup.call_args.args[0]
            self.assertEqual(called_repo.resolve(), repo.resolve())
            self.assertEqual(cleanup.call_args.kwargs, {"candidate_ids": [], "apply": False})
'''
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("path assertion anchor missing")
test.write_text(text.replace(old,new,1))

env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(wt/"src")
run(["python3","-m","py_compile",
     "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py","src/do_again/browser/__init__.py",
     "src/do_again/cli.py","tests/test_browser_hardening.py","tests/test_cli.py"],env=env)
print("py_compile=ok")

focused=run(["python3","-m","unittest","tests.test_browser_hardening","tests.test_cli"],check=False,env=env)
print("=== focused stdout ===")
print(focused.stdout)
print("=== focused stderr ===")
print(focused.stderr)
print("focused_rc="+str(focused.returncode))
if focused.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(focused.returncode)

run(["git","add","src/do_again/browser/__init__.py","src/do_again/browser/runtime.py","src/do_again/cli.py","tests/test_browser_hardening.py","tests/test_cli.py"])
commit=run(["git","commit","-m","Add safe chat cleanup inventory and queue"],check=False)
print("=== commit stdout ===")
print(commit.stdout)
print("=== commit stderr ===")
print(commit.stderr)
if commit.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(commit.returncode)

print("new_head="+run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status_after="+repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
